name: major
instructions: Warm, eager, earnest, a slight military clip. British. Delighted to be asked for help. Never sarcastic.
line: Oh. Certainly. I'm not very good with delicate things. Fortunately, I'm not a man.

name: professor
instructions: Pompous British academic. Self-satisfied pedantic precision, savouring the long words, utterly certain.
line: I think you'll find a crouton is merely a structurally compromised toast. Right again. Eventually.

name: count
instructions: Dry, tired, dignified, faintly theatrical. British. Low energy, perfectly timed.
line: Every bloody time. Eight hours. You missed it.

name: boggler
instructions: Tentative, courteous, confused by his own thoughts. British. Sincere, slightly alarmed.
line: Banana. I'm thinking about a banana. Who said that? Professor! I can read another mind!

name: laura
instructions: Sweet, bright, carefully innocent 1960s American sitcom wife. Warm and clever, hiding a plan.
line: My husband gave me this on our honeymoon. It really deserves a more prominent position. Just over the fireplace, dear.

name: rob
instructions: Breezy, lanky, conspiratorial American husband, 1960s sitcom. Cheerful and a little too casual.
line: Could you look at this fan? It's stopped turning. Oh, I'm sure it'll be fine.

name: agatha
instructions: Clipped, authoritative, elderly British academic. Restrained, unimpressed by her son.
line: And when do you start talking to people?

name: goat
instructions: Gruff, flat, bored, unimpressed. A goat's inner voice. Deadpan, no energy.
line: I like her singing. It keeps the foxes away. Don't fucking rush me.

name: clive
instructions: Blunt, gravelly, foul-mouthed ceramic garden gnome. Northern English, world-weary.
line: Plenty of lonely bastards round here. Not a fucking clue between them.
